name: @w6w-apps/helpscout
description: Manage Help Scout conversations, customers and mailboxes, and start workflows on new conversations, customer replies, status changes and new customers.

w6w.longDescription:
Help Scout is a shared-inbox help desk, and this app manages the conversations, customers, and mailboxes behind it: listing and reading conversations, replying to a customer or leaving an internal note, and updating a conversation's status, assignee, or mailbox. It is built for workflows that need to act on support tickets — routing, triaging, or replying — rather than just observing them.

Customer records can be created, read, updated, and searched, so a workflow can keep customer details in sync with another system or look someone up before replying on their behalf. Conversations and customers both support partial updates — changing just a status or a handful of fields — without having to resend the whole record, and the mailbox and tag lists round out the reference data other actions depend on, such as knowing which mailbox to file a new conversation into.

Triggers start a workflow from Help Scout itself: a new conversation, a customer reply, a conversation's status changing, or a new customer. Each trigger registers a Help Scout webhook for you and checks Help Scout's signature on every delivery, so only real Help Scout events start a run.
